attributes.content:
Rooms that feel
like you.
Calm, liveable interiors for homes and small workplaces – planned around how you actually live, not how a magazine does.
We design quiet, warm interiors with fewer, better things – natural materials, soft light and furniture that will still feel right in ten years.

Four ways
to work with us.
Full interior design
Concept, layout, materials, lighting and furniture for a whole home – drawings your builder can price.
One room done properly: a living room, kitchen or bedroom, start to finish.
A palette, samples and a shopping list when the layout already works.
The last 10%: lamps, textiles, art and objects that make a room feel finished.
Three steps, no surprises.
A two-hour visit: how you live, what stays, what drives you mad. You get a short brief the same week.
Layouts, a material board and lighting plan. Two rounds of changes, then drawings.
We order, coordinate the trades and style the rooms – or hand you a clear shopping list.

Start with a
conversation.
Not sure what you need? Most clients start with a colour call and grow from there – the fee counts towards any bigger project.
60-minute video call with a designer, a palette and three paint names.
One room designed with layout, materials, lighting and a shopping list.
The full design of a home, with drawings and project management on request.

Pieces we specify
again and again.
Lighting and ceramics from small makers, ready to ship.
They listened more than they talked – and the flat finally feels like ours, not like a showroom.
Interior design studio for calm, liveable homes. Copenhagen and remote across Scandinavia.
